subject.title: California Supreme Court — Retain Justice Kelli M. Evans

text: Associate Justice, Supreme Court of California
University of California Davis School of Law, J.D., 1994; Stanford University, B.A., 1991.

Chief Deputy Legal Affairs Secretary, Office of Governor Gavin Newsom (2019–2021); Special Assistant Attorney General, California Department of Justice (2017–2019); Senior Director, Administration of Justice, State Bar of California (2014–2017); Federal Court Monitor, U.S. District Court, Northern District of California (2003–2010) & U.S. District Court, Northern District of Ohio (2015–2017); Attorney, Relman & Associates (2001–2004); Senior Trial Attorney, U.S. Department of Justice Civil Rights Division (1998–2001); Staff Attorney & Associate Director, ACLU of Northern California (1995–1998 & 2010–2013); Assistant Public Defender, Sacramento County (1995); Ruth Chance Litigation Fellow, Equal Rights Advocates (1994–1995).
Associate Justice, Supreme Court of California, 2023–present; Judge, Alameda County Superior Court, 2021–2022.
